items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: But then Bob got drafted in the army... So I got offered... a job at the Cafe Society downtown... but I would have to take his men, his personnel.

ctx.x: Right. But then Bob got drafted in the army, and the Second World War was coming, you know, and this was about 1940 and they were put on the draft, and everybody went --

So I got offered, during that time, a job at the Cafe Society downtown, which was due to John Hammond's work again, because he never liked my big band, and so he offered me a job, a steady, year round job as a band leader at the Cafe Society, but I would have to take his men, his personnel.
